- [x] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

Resolve #2560
Resolve #2566

This PR uses `on_jump` instead of `float` when version >= 0.13

I used the code submitted in [this](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/pull/34037) PR

I made sure to never override a `on_jump` the user may have added to `diagnostic.config`

comment_data.body:
```suggestion
      local default_opts = { bufnr = bufnr, scope = 'cursor', focus = false }
      vim.diagnostic.open_float(vim.tbl_extend('force', default_opts, float))
```

Both `vim.tbl_extend` and `vim.tbl_deep_extend` are always used with `'force'` method for consistency.

comment_data.body: Both `on_jump` and `vim.diagnostic.open_float` are available on Neovim>=0.12, so it is better to use them earlier. And please prefer using a more recent condition on top, so that it goes "the current" - "less recent" - "even less recent" - etc.

comment_data.body:
I changed `float ~= nil` into `float ~= false`, as according to the help of vim.diagnostic.Opts that's the only way to disable float. 
Looking at the code, float never is nil

comment_data.body:
```suggestion
  if child.fn.has('nvim-0.12') == 0 then MiniTest.skip('Diagnostic `on_jump` was introduced in Neovim=0.12') end
```

Using `vim.fn.has` to test a version will probably work most of the time, but using `child.fn.has` is a more clear intent for "skip if tested Neovim is not right version".
